summary: Reclaim unused 7d project artifacts and state partitions in auto and target cleanup

delivery.outcome: Reclaim unused 7-day-old date-partitioned state data and safe developer project artifacts in fixos auto, cleanup --free-gb, and cleanup --projects-old/--state-old while preserving active/recent projects, user files, and persistent releases.
nonGoals: Do not delete user personal files, Downloads, Videos, persistent deployment releases/snapshots, or active/recently modified (< 7 days) projects and worktrees

architecture.decision: Set default state partition and project staleness retention to 7 days; add safe 7-day unused project artifact scanner and cleanup handler (_cleanup_projects_old) with process/symlink/mount/source-activity guards; wire 7-day state-old and projects-old into fixos auto and the free-target ladder; optimize venv_cleanup.inspect_project to skip full source scans when a project has no venv/.venv.
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-101 commit via protected publication.

commands: pytest tests/unit/test_auto_cleanup.py tests/unit/test_cleanup_space.py tests/unit/test_cleanup_free_target.py tests/unit/test_venv_cleanup.py tests/unit/test_state_retention.py tests/unit/test_project_scanner.py -q
